title: wanted to move from heroku to google cloud issus with opening the virtual monitor next day
symptom: User attempted to move Nightscout from Heroku to Google Cloud, but when clicking SSH on the virtual machine instance, they get a failure message about lacking IAM permission compute.instances.setMetadata. Later, they encountered a billing error stating that the API method requires billing to be enabled.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user encountered IAM permission and billing issues, but the cause is not clearly identified.
fix: The thread suggests trying again, restarting the machine, and ensuring billing is enabled. The user reported that after confirming payment terms and logging out/in, they could continue. No specific configuration change is stated.
evidence_quote: After confirming payment terms a few times and logout and login in google it is possible to continou.
